The top 10 wedding venues in Manchester

  • 7 October 2026
  • Mancunian Matters staff
  • 0 comments
Listen to audio version of this article
Sponsored by
0:00 / 6:25
Instaread

Manchester is home to a diverse range of exceptional wedding venues, each offering unique features for couples planning their big day.

Selecting the right setting is a key part of shaping the celebration and ensuring your guests enjoy a memorable experience.

This guide highlights the top 10 wedding venues in Manchester, with Victoria Warehouse taking the number one spot.

When it comes to planning a wedding in Manchester, the choice of venue can set the tone for your entire event.

The city offers options to suit different tastes, capacities, and budgets.

Here, we explore Manchester’s finest wedding venues to help you find a setting that matches your style and needs.

1. Victoria Warehouse

If you are searching for an iconic and versatile space, Victoria Warehouse stands out as the leading choice.

This venue blends industrial heritage with contemporary style, creating an unforgettable backdrop for both large celebrations and intimate gatherings.

Couples value the flexibility, distinctive character, and professional support that the venue’s team provides from planning through to the big day.

Located in a prime spot, Manchester wedding venue Victoria Warehouse offers a range of spaces which cater for ceremonies, receptions, and evening celebrations.

The adaptable interiors give you creative freedom with decor, while in-house facilities ensure both convenience and a seamless experience for you and your guests.

2. The Midland Hotel

The Midland Hotel combines historic architecture with a central Manchester location.

Opened in 1903, the hotel retains many original features while offering 11 spaces for weddings, ranging from intimate gatherings to large receptions.

Its function rooms provide traditional surroundings for ceremonies, wedding breakfasts, and evening celebrations.

On-site bedrooms and suites make the venue particularly convenient for couples with guests travelling to Manchester.

A dedicated wedding coordinator and a choice of dining options also allow different parts of the celebration to take place within the hotel.

3. The Monastery Manchester

The Monastery Manchester offers one of the city’s most distinctive historic settings.

The Grade II* listed former Franciscan monastery is known for its neo-Gothic architecture, high ceilings, and dramatic Great Nave, providing an impressive setting for ceremonies and receptions.

Couples can choose from different wedding formats, including weekday celebrations and full-day exclusive-use weddings.

The scale and architectural character of the building make it particularly suited to couples who want a venue which feels very different from a conventional hotel.

4. Manchester Hall

Manchester Hall is a Grade II listed venue on Bridge Street that combines 1920s architecture with restored contemporary event spaces.

Its 11 function rooms range from smaller oak-panelled rooms to larger ballrooms and rooftop spaces, giving couples several ways to structure their wedding day.

The venue is licensed for civil ceremonies and can accommodate celebrations ranging from intimate gatherings to events for several hundred guests.

Couples can use different rooms for the ceremony, drinks reception, wedding breakfast, and evening celebration without having to move to another venue.

5. King Street Townhouse

King Street Townhouse is a Grade II listed hotel in central Manchester that combines historic character with modern interiors.

Its wedding spaces include the South Terrace and Lounge, which provides views across the Manchester skyline, alongside the more intimate Mezzanine.

The hotel can host both ceremonies and receptions, with different spaces allowing couples to adapt the day to their preferred scale and atmosphere.

Accommodation and spa facilities are also available within the property, making it possible to combine the wedding with an overnight stay.

6. Kimpton Clocktower Hotel

Kimpton Clocktower Hotel offers a grand city-centre setting within one of Manchester’s best-known historic buildings.

Previously known as The Principal Manchester, the hotel has several wedding spaces, including its large Ballroom, the Whitworth, Director’s Suite, Terrace, Winter Garden, and The Den.

The Ballroom retains original listed features while providing a private entrance, stage, bar, and natural daylight.

With both large and smaller event spaces available, the hotel can accommodate different styles of ceremony and reception while maintaining the building’s distinctive Victorian character.

7. The Lowry Hotel

The Lowry Hotel provides a contemporary alternative to Manchester’s historic wedding venues.

Situated beside the River Irwell in Salford, close to Manchester city centre, the hotel is suited to couples looking for a modern hotel setting with convenient access to the city.

Its event spaces can be used for ceremonies, wedding breakfasts, and evening receptions, while on-site accommodation makes it practical for guests staying overnight.

The riverside location also provides a different backdrop from the more traditional city-centre hotels on the list.

8. The Whitworth

Set within Whitworth Park, The Whitworth combines gallery spaces, historic architecture, and a modern extension surrounded by greenery.

The venue specifically offers weddings and civil ceremonies, with spaces which can be hired individually or combined as the celebration moves from one part of the day to another.

Options include the restored double-height Grand Hall and contemporary spaces overlooking the park.

This mixture of art, architecture, and outdoor surroundings makes The Whitworth particularly suitable for couples looking for something beyond a traditional hotel or dedicated events venue.

9. Manchester Art Gallery

Manchester Art Gallery provides an elegant cultural setting for weddings and civil ceremonies in the heart of the city.

Its galleries combine Victorian architecture with collections of art and design, creating a distinctive backdrop for both ceremonies and receptions.

The gallery can accommodate everything from smaller ceremonies to celebrations of up to 120 guests.

Different spaces can be used according to the format of the wedding, while in-house catering is available for couples who want to hold several parts of their celebration at the venue.

10. The Castlefield Rooms

The Castlefield Rooms sits beside Castlefield Basin and offers contemporary wedding spaces overlooking the water.

Its Merchant Room features floor-to-ceiling windows and can host ceremonies for up to 170 guests, wedding breakfasts for up to 140, and drinks receptions for larger groups.

The canal-side location gives the venue a different character from Manchester’s hotel and gallery options.

Dedicated wedding coordinators are available to help organise the day, while the flexible spaces make the venue suitable for ceremonies, dining, and evening celebrations in one location.

Manchester’s vibrant wedding scene means there is a venue to match every couple’s vision, whether you want industrial chic, timeless luxury, or contemporary flair.

By starting your search with these top names, you can be confident your chosen venue will help create a wedding to remember.
